description: Manually defined questions and expected answers. 'expected' lists strings that a correct answer must mention (any one alias inside an inner list counts). 'sources' lists the documents that support the answer.

questions.question: Which products were developed by Acme AI?
Who leads the team responsible for VisionCore?
questions.notes: VisionCore <-OWNS- VisionCore Team <-LEADS- Sarah Chen. The legacy wiki contradicts this with David Okafor.

questions.question: Which technologies does VisionCore depend on?

How is Northwind Robotics connected to PostgreSQL?
Who leads the team that owns the project which depends on PostgreSQL?
questions.notes: Project Cobalt -DEPENDS_ON-> PostgreSQL; Platform Team -OWNS-> Project Cobalt; Priya Raman leads it since 2025.
